# netbox_circuit_group_assignments (Data Source)

Lists circuit_group_assignment objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_circuit_group_assignments" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: group_id, group_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, member_id, member_id__n, member_type, member_type__n, priority, priority__empty, priority__ic, priority__ie, priority__iew, priority__iregex, priority__isw, priority__n, priority__nic, priority__nie, priority__niew, priority__nisw, priority__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `circuit_group_assignments` (Attributes List) The matching circuit_group_assignments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--circuit_group_assignments))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--circuit_group_assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `circuit_group_assignments`

Read-Only:

- `circuit_group_id` (Number) Id of the circuit group the member is assigned to.
- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `member_id` (Number) Id of the assigned circuit or virtual circuit.
- `member_type` (String) Content type of the assigned member. One of: circuits.circuit, circuits.virtualcircuit.
- `priority` (String) Priority of this member within the group. One of: primary, secondary, tertiary, inactive.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
